name: Beijing Fjr Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Fjr Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a prominent producer of advanced optoelectronic solutions, specializing in infrared thermal imaging movement components and photoelectric sensors. These specialized products are integral to a wide array of applications, spanning from security monitoring and national defense to industrial testing and thermal measurement. Further uses include critical areas like fire search and rescue operations, advanced vehicle assisted driving systems, and various scientific research endeavors. Established in 2011, the company maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China.
